en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, no author known. 'Потуреша' means a woman from the Potur (Muslim Slavic) community; 'ми' in several lines is a dialect filler. 'Калеши јаганца' I read as 'speckled lamb', my reading.

lines.en: She was left, left, a widowed woman,
a widow with one male child,
she gave him the name Asan Aga.

lines.cyr: Расна Асан, расна Асан, расна ми порасна,
lines.lat: Rasna Asan, rasna Asan, rasna mi porasna,
lines.en: Asan grew, Asan grew, he grew up,

lines.cyr: па истера овци да ми пасе,
lines.lat: pa istera ovci da mi pase,
lines.en: and drove out the sheep to graze,

lines.cyr: да ги пасе низ Потур Маале.
lines.lat: da gi pase niz Potur Maale.
lines.en: to graze them through Potur Quarter.

lines.cyr: Там' ја најде, там' ја најде Фатма потуреша,
lines.lat: Tam' ja najde, tam' ja najde Fatma potureša,
lines.en: There he found, there he found Fatma the Potur girl,
she was grazing a speckled lamb,
the sheep and lambs got mixed up,
it began, they gave a firm vow

lines.cyr: да се љубат, да не се излажат.
lines.lat: da se ljubat, da ne se izlažat.
lines.en: to love each other, not to deceive each other.
